The plate holds what looks like 3 to 4 strips of cooked bacon. Cooked bacon runs about 40-45 kcal per slice, at roughly 8 g per slice. Some of these strips look fairly thick, so I'll assume about 4 strips (two overlapping at the top, two at the bottom) at about 9 g each, or roughly 33 g in total. Cooked bacon is about 540 kcal per 100 g, so 33 g comes to about 180 kcal.
